title: Boundary layers control table
description: Canonical control table for every boundary geometry shard on disk under datasets/boundaries/. One row per (level, partition) — e.g. one row for the national states outline, one row per state's AC layer, one row per (state, district) village shard. Replaces the per-file .sources.json + .metadata.json + .unkeyed.json + per-state -index.json sidecars that pre-dated T.0d (115 files retired in the T.0d fused atomic commit). FK source_id resolves to taxonomy/sources.parquet (citation triple per ADR-0032 §12 v2.0). Authored shape JSON (D18 — this schema documents the parquet column contract; the parquet itself is COMPILED by tools/boundaries/snapshot.py which calls boundary_layers_seed.compile_to_parquet, not hand-authored). Hive-partitioned discovery path matches elections/state=in_<S>/... grammar (T.0d §1). Amends ADR-0031 (Status: Accepted → Amended 2026-05-22).

x-changelog.description: Initial canonical boundary-layers control table schema (T.0d of TODO/20260517-canonical-long-format-pivot.md §0e.7). 17 columns: 10 required (layer_id PK + level + partition_path + format + crs + original_feature_count + retained_feature_count + unkeyed_count + size_bytes + source_id FK) + 7 nullable (entity_state, entity_district, entity_city, simplification_algorithm, simplification_tolerance_deg, unkeyed_keys_json, notes). Spec text in TODO/20260522-t0d-boundaries-consolidation-spec.md §2 said '12 required + 3 optional = 15' which counted from an earlier iteration; the §2 column listing carried the 17-column shape that landed. Replaces boundary.sources.schema.json + boundary.unkeyed.schema.json + boundary.villages_index.schema.json (all retired in this T.0d commit). feature_collection.metadata.schema.json is preserved (still used by backend/yen_gov/sources/india_geodata/power_plants.py for the non-boundary power-plants feature collection).

Add optional nullable `delimitation_vintage` column to the per-layer row shape (4-digit year string e.g. '2024', '2008'). Required for electoral-constituency layers (level='ac' or 'pc') to disambiguate which Delimitation Commission Order the geometry reflects; pre-2008 elections need pre-Delim boundaries, 2009–2024 elections use the 2008 Delim with state-specific overrides (J&K 2022, Assam 2023). Null for non-electoral layers (country/state/district/subdistrict/village/postal). This enables Hive-partitioning by `delim=<year>` under `boundaries/in/<level>/delim=<year>/...` so pre-2019 LS data can coexist with the 2024-Delim PC layer without overwriting; the partition segment matches the existing layer_id grammar regex without further change. Additive: existing rows get null; no migration needed. Lands in the same commit as the first PC layer ingest (shijithpk/2024_maps_supplement, georeferenced from ECI Press Note No. 23).

Add 'block' to the level enum. Phase C.1 of TODO/20260529-boundary-rip-and-replace-plan.md introduces the LGD Development Block admin tier (~7,323 features across India, sourced from ramSeraph LGD_Blocks.geojsonl.7z, BharatMaps/LGD lineage). Block is a SEPARATE admin tier from subdistrict per LGD (7,323 Blocks vs 7,090 Sub-Districts; yen-gov already ships subdistricts via lift_subdistricts_national.py). Required for rural-development indicators (PMGSY, MGNREGA) that bind at block granularity. Additive: existing rows with level in the 1.1 enum continue to validate; new lift writes rows with level='block'. Per-state Hive partitions live under boundaries/in/blocks/state=in_<lc>/all.geojson, mirroring the subdistricts layout. Recon verdict + 6-step implementation plan at notes/2026-05-29-c1-blocks-source-hunt-verdict.md.

Add 'panchayat' to the level enum. Phase C.2 of TODO/20260529-boundary-rip-and-replace-plan.md introduces the LGD Gram Panchayat admin tier (~255,304 features per LGD Directory; ~225-245k emitted actually due to ~9-state coverage gap in HP/J&K/Sikkim/NE; sourced from ramSeraph LGD_panchayats.geojsonl.7z, BharatMaps/LGD lineage). Gram Panchayat is the lowest formal LGD admin tier above the village (a GP aggregates 5-30 revenue villages). Required for any indicator that binds at panchayat granularity (15th Finance Commission GP grants, SBM-G, MGNREGA panchayat-rolls). Additive: existing rows with level in the 1.2 enum continue to validate; new lift writes rows with level='panchayat'. Per-(state, district) Hive partitions live under boundaries/in/panchayats/state=in_<lc>/district=<lgd>/all.geojson, mirroring the villages layout (nested district-keyed because per-state GP counts (300-2500 polygons/state) would blow the 12 MB shard budget for any high-density state). Recon verdict + 10-step implementation plan at notes/2026-05-30-c2-panchayats-source-hunt-verdict.md.

Add 'ward' to the level enum. Phase C.3.a of TODO/20260529-boundary-rip-and-replace-plan.md introduces the LGD ULB Ward admin tier (~250-350k features nationally across ~4,500+ ULBs; sourced from ramSeraph SBM_Wards.geojsonl.7z, Swachh Bharat Mission Urban / Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs lineage, CC0 1.0). ULB Ward is the lowest urban LGD admin tier — the elected ward councillor unit (Municipal Corporation / Municipality / Nagar Panchayat ward). Required for urban-governance indicators (Swachh Survekshan rankings, AMRUT works, municipal corporation budget data). Distinct from GP Ward (rural sub-panchayat ward; separate LGD entity class, not in scope — SBM is urban-only by mandate). Coverage gap (documented upstream): SBM missing West Bengal, Tripura, Mizoram, Manipur; LivingAtlas + WB_AMRUT + Shillong reserved as Tier-1.5/2 gap-fills (optional C.3.d). Additive: existing rows with level in the 1.3 enum continue to validate; new lift writes rows with level='ward'. Per-(state, ulb) Hive partitions live under boundaries/in/wards/state=in_<lc>/ulb=<ulb_lgd>/all.geojson — keyed by ULB (not district) because LGD treats ULB as the primary urban entity with its own LGD code (a ULB can span multiple districts; LGD tracks ULB-to-district as M:N). Recon verdict + 5-step implementation plan at notes/2026-05-30-c3-ulb-wards-source-hunt-verdict.md.

layer_id.description: PK. Dot-separated handle derived from partition_path; e.g. 'boundaries.in.states' for the national outline, 'boundaries.in.ac.state=in_s22' for TN ACs, 'boundaries.in.villages.state=in_s22.district=603' for a per-district village shard. Stable across rebuilds; the renderer + manifest.json table_id column both key on this.

level.description: Admin-spine level per T.0d §1. country = national outline; state = state polygon; district = LGD district carve-outs; ac/pc = ECI assembly/parliamentary constituencies; subdistrict = LGD subdistrict; block = LGD Development Block (separate LGD tier from subdistrict — 7,323 Blocks vs 7,090 Sub-Districts; binds PMGSY / MGNREGA rural-development indicators per Phase C.1 of TODO/20260529-boundary-rip-and-replace-plan.md); panchayat = LGD Gram Panchayat (~255k features, aggregates 5-30 revenue villages; binds 15th Finance Commission GP grants + SBM-G + MGNREGA panchayat-rolls per Phase C.2 of the same plan); village = LGD village; ward = LGD ULB Ward (~250-350k features across ~4,500+ ULBs; the elected ward-councillor unit under a Municipal Corporation / Municipality / Nagar Panchayat; sourced from ramSeraph SBM_Wards.geojsonl.7z — Swachh Bharat Mission Urban / MoHUA lineage, CC0 1.0; distinct LGD entity class from GP Ward which is rural sub-panchayat and out of scope; binds Swachh Survekshan rankings + AMRUT + municipal corporation budgets per Phase C.3.a of the same plan; coverage gap: SBM missing WB/TR/MZ/MN — optional Tier-1.5/2 gap-fills documented at notes/2026-05-30-c3-ulb-wards-source-hunt-verdict.md); postal = pincode (orthogonal — NOT in the LGD admin spine; sits as a peer alongside the admin levels per ADR-0031).

entity_state.description: ECI state code (S22, U07, ...) when this layer is per-state; null for national layers. Used by the renderer to filter to the active state.

entity_district.description: LGD district code (numeric string) when this layer is per-district (today: only village shards); null otherwise.

entity_city.description: Urban entity code when this layer is keyed to a city/ULB scope. Per Phase C.3.a of TODO/20260529-boundary-rip-and-replace-plan.md the ward layer populates this with the LGD ULB code (numeric string e.g. '802743') so per-(state, ulb) ward shards can resolve their parent ULB in the registry. Postal pincode geometries (no entries yet — KMZ pending ingest) will use this for city scope when ingested. Null for non-city-keyed layers (national/state/district/block/panchayat/village admin spine). NOT an LGD admin-spine code; ULB and pincode are both orthogonal entity classes that the LGD entity directory tracks separately from the admin spine.

partition_path.description: Relative path under datasets/ to the geometry file. Hive-partitioned per T.0d §1: 'boundaries/in/states/all.geojson', 'boundaries/in/ac/state=in_s22/all.geojson', 'boundaries/in/villages/state=in_s22/district=603/all.geojson'. Always POSIX separators (CLAUDE.md §2). The format column says whether the file is .geojson or .pmtiles.

format.description: Container format for the geometry. geojson = RFC 7946 FeatureCollection (today's default — frontend loads via maplibre-gl GeoJSON source). pmtiles = ADR-0031 PMTiles archive (range-requestable; used when a layer trips the 10 MB cutover threshold). The loader switches read paths off this column — no separate pmtiles/ subtree.

crs.description: Coordinate reference system identifier (e.g. 'EPSG:4326' = WGS84 lat/lon, the GeoJSON default per RFC 7946). All current boundary files are EPSG:4326; the column exists so a future projected layer (UTM, Lambert) can be carried without a schema bump.

simplification_algorithm.description: Geometry simplification algorithm applied during snapshot (per boundaries.md). douglas-peucker / visvalingam = standard topology-preserving thinning. shapely-preserve-topology = Shapely.simplify with preserve_topology=True. coord-precision-round = no thinning, just coordinate-precision rounding. 'none' = raw upstream geometry copied verbatim. Null = unknown / pre-T.0d artifact.

simplification_tolerance_deg.description: Algorithm-specific tolerance in decimal degrees (or precision digits for coord-precision-round). Null when simplification_algorithm is 'none' or null.

original_feature_count.description: Number of features in the upstream geometry BEFORE simplification / unkeyed-drop. Citizen-trust signal: the denominator for what we started with. Denominator-transparency invariant: original = retained + unkeyed (asserted at compile time).

retained_feature_count.description: Number of features in the published partition_path artifact AFTER simplification + unkeyed drop. Numerator of the denominator-transparency invariant.

unkeyed_count.description: Number of upstream features dropped because they had no usable join key (no AC_NO, no LGD code, no ST_NM match). Citizen-trust signal: the 'we lost N features and here are their names' tail. Lives on the citizen-facing row (not in .runtime/) so users can ask 'why is my village missing'.

unkeyed_keys_json.description: Operator-detail companion to unkeyed_count. Small JSON array of name strings (typically <50) identifying which features were dropped. Stored as a JSON-encoded string column for parquet portability; the renderer decodes when surfacing operator diagnostics. Null when unkeyed_count = 0.

size_bytes.description: Byte size of the published partition_path artifact. Used by the renderer to choose loader (>10MB triggers PMTiles consideration per ADR-0031) and by the operator to flag size regressions.

source_id.description: FK to taxonomy/sources.parquet. The citation triple (producer, title, vintage) for this geometry. T.0d seeds 4 boundary sources: DataMeet India Maps (state outlines), Hindustan Times Labs (AC layers from 2008 Delimitation), shijithpk (J&K 2024 AC re-georeferencing), ramSeraph (LGD-keyed admin boundaries). Postal sources NOT seeded — no pincode geojson exists today; postal subtree is forward-looking only.

notes.description: Operator-visible free-text note (e.g. 'upstream MIT applied to data; treated as attribution-only', 'J&K 2024 re-georef from shijithpk; supersedes pre-2019 boundary'). Optional; NOT citizen-facing.

delimitation_vintage.description: 4-digit year of the Delimitation Commission Order that this boundary set reflects. Used for electoral-constituency layers only (level='ac' or 'pc') to disambiguate which boundary generation a shard belongs to. Examples: '2024' for the 2024 LS map incorporating J&K 2022 + Assam 2023 reorganisations; '2008' for the post-2008 Delim baseline; '1976' for the pre-2008 boundaries needed by pre-2009 elections. Null for non-electoral layers (country/state/district/subdistrict/village/postal admin spine). When set, the partition_path is expected to carry a `delim=<year>` Hive segment (e.g. boundaries/in/pc/delim=2024/all.geojson).
